is_anopheles.evidence: The study collected and analysed Anopheles mosquitoes including Anopheles gambiae (s.s.), An. arabiensis, and An. funestus (s.s.) in Uganda (Page 1, Abstract; Page 4, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped Vgsc-L1014S (Vgsc L995S), Vgsc-L1014F (Vgsc L995F), Vgsc-N1575Y (Vgsc N1570Y), and Cyp4j5-L43F (Page 4, Molecular analysis; Page 5, Results).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 5 reports total genotyped numbers (1368 An. gambiae s.s. and 88 An. arabiensis) along with overall allele frequencies (e.g. In An. gambiae s.s., L1014S frequency = 0.94, L1014F = 0.06, Cyp4j5-L43F = 0.60; in An. arabiensis, wild-type = 0.96, L1014S = 0.01, L1014F = 0.03).

african_field_population.evidence: Field mosquito collections were conducted in 1029 houses across 104 health sub-districts (48 districts) in eastern and western Uganda in 2017–2018 (Page 2, Background; Page 4, Results).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article reporting original baseline entomological surveillance data for the LLINEUP cluster randomised trial in Uganda (Page 1-2).

sub_country_location.evidence: Mosquito collections are specified by health sub-districts (HSDs) and administrative districts across Eastern and Western regions of Uganda (Page 2, Fig 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted during the baseline survey in 2017–2018 (Page 2, Background).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This paper presents the primary baseline entomological dataset collected for the LLINEUP trial in Uganda.

supplement.evidence: Overall allele frequencies and species-specific sample sizes are reported directly in the main text (Page 5).

assessment.summary: This primary study reports baseline entomological surveillance for the LLINEUP trial in 48 districts (104 health sub-districts) of Uganda in 2017–2018. Molecular diagnostics were performed on 1368 An. gambiae s.s. and 88 An. arabiensis to evaluate pyrethroid resistance markers including Vgsc-L1014S, Vgsc-L1014F, Vgsc-N1575Y, and Cyp4j5-L43F.
